goal: Deliver Phase 2 backend lane: hardened ai_jobs lifecycle and non-blocking insight fallback for execution sessions without regressing Phase 1 core loop stability.

constraints.notes: No unapproved schema redesign or deploy changes. Preserve backward compatibility with existing ingest paths.

acceptance: ai_jobs lifecycle (queued/running/succeeded/failed) remains deterministic for minimum Phase 2 job set.
session insights/week insight keep immediate response under AI delay/failure via rule fallback.
Core loop endpoints remain non-blocking and backward-compatible.
Schema-valid result/handoff with reproducible evidence paths is published.

risk.note: Async state drift can create stale/duplicate recommendation outputs if idempotency/fallback checks are weak.

next_actions: Harden minimum async lifecycle behavior and fallback branches first.
Add/refresh tests for delayed/failed job non-blocking guarantees.
Publish schema-valid backend phase2 result/handoff artifacts.
